title: Check Point ZoneAlarm Symlink Following Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Check Point ZoneAlarm. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ZoneAlarm Service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied symbolic link prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
